{{Otheruses|Canister}}
A '''CryoBan canister''' was an ammunition type for use with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]] loaded with [[CryoBan/Legends|CryoBan]]. It was used to inflict freezing damage on a target and incapacitate it.
